title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis), daily temperature_2m_max
summary: Open-Meteo historical weather archive endpoint, queried by latitude/longitude and timezone, returning hourly and daily values per requested location. For UC2 (N3) the relevant field is daily temperature_2m_max in degrees Celsius. Probes returned data for a northern-Italian grid point (45.448 N, 9.169 E, elevation 138 m) for 2023-06-01 to 2023-06-03, 2025-06-01 to 2025-06-05 and 2026-03-25 to 2026-03-31, so the whole history and recent windows were reachable at the probe ends. Grain is hourly with daily aggregates; the shop's own location is not established in the sources read.

fields.description: Day of the daily series, in the requested timezone

fields.name: temperature_2m_max
fields.description: Daily maximum of air temperature at 2 m

spatial.code_system: decimal latitude/longitude (WGS84); the API snaps to a grid cell (returned 45.448154, 9.169279)
spatial.notes: Probe coordinates 45.46, 9.19 were chosen by the profiler (Milan area) for testing only; no decisions.md or other source fixing the shop's coordinates was found in the catalog search. The register default (Lisbon, 38.72, -9.14) is not Italian and must be replaced.

access.request_process: GET https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive with latitude, longitude, start_date, end_date, daily=temperature_2m_max, timezone=Europe/Rome. Register lists approved_purposes prototyping and production; no agreement needed.

documentation_excerpts: Register param_notes: latitude/longitude decimal degrees; start_date/end_date YYYY-MM-DD; hourly or daily variable lists. Keep probe ranges to a few days.
Licence page (open-meteo.com/en/licence): API data are offered under Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
Licence page: Weather reanalysis, air quality forecasts and elevation data from Copernicus Climate Change Service C3S (Licence)
quality_notes: Register default coordinates (38.72, -9.14, Lisbon) and default timezone (UTC) are not Italian; the candidate's suspected issue is confirmed. The probes used 45.46, 9.19 and Europe/Rome, which the API accepted, returning utc_offset_seconds 3600.
The candidate cites decisions.md for an assumed Italian city. A catalog search for it returned no such page, so that coordinate choice is not verified; the shop location remains unknown.
The default query adds hourly temperature_2m and shortwave_radiation even when only daily temperature_2m_max is requested; the response carries both. Harmless but needs to be filtered out.
Reanalysis smooths extremes compared with station observations (candidate's note). Not verified against a source document in this profile; no station data was read.
Recent window: probe confirmed data to 2026-03-31 (max_date returned for the 2026-03-25 to 2026-03-31 probe). Full 2025-06-01 to 2026-03-31 coverage was not fetched; only the ends were checked.
Archive refresh cadence and the revision policy for recent days (provisional vs final values) were not found in the sources read.
sample_findings: Probe 2023-06-01 to 2023-06-03 (Europe/Rome, 45.448N 9.169E): daily temperature_2m_max returned 25.3, 25.7, 24.9 degrees C; no nulls or sentinel values in the 3 values shown.

Probe 2025-06-01 to 2025-06-05: daily temperature_2m_max returned 30.7, 27.3, 24.5 and two more values; hourly temperature_2m included values such as 22.5, 21.8, 21.3 degrees C; no -999 or -200 sentinels seen.
Probe 2026-03-25 to 2026-03-31: daily temperature_2m_max values include 17.7, 12.8, 15.4 degrees C; plausible for late March in northern Italy; no sentinels seen.
Dates returned as ISO8601 day strings; timezone abbreviation GMT+1 with utc_offset_seconds 3600 for Europe/Rome; elevation 138 m for the grid cell.

unknowns: Which upstream dataset backs the archive endpoint and its exact licence (the licence page lists C3S reanalysis but does not map it to this endpoint).
Shop's actual location (city/coordinates) and whether the candidate's decisions.md choice exists; the probe used Milan-area coordinates chosen by the profiler.
Full coverage across 2025-06-01 to 2026-03-31 and the earliest available date (only the 2023-06-01 start was probed).
Refresh cadence, revision policy for recent days, and metadata last-updated date.
Accuracy of daily maxima versus station observations for Italian sites (not evaluated; candidate's smoothing note is not verified here).
Whether commercial use is permitted under the upstream Copernicus terms (CC BY 4.0 is stated for API data but commercial use under the upstream terms was not confirmed).
